title: MobilityJob
description: The onward journey of the driver once the vehicle is gone. Today this is arranged separately, by phone, and usually only after the vehicle has already left; here it starts at the same moment as the recovery matching. Held in the eVault of the driver, because it is the one part of the case that is genuinely theirs rather than the vehicle. linkedRepairJobEnvelopeId is what lets a replacement period extend when the repair completion date moves, and lets the return of the replacement vehicle be scheduled against the delivery of the repaired one.

driverEName.description: eName of the driver who needs onward transport

incidentEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the Incident, where the job is part of a case

type.description: What kind of onward transport is arranged

peopleToMove.description: Number of people to move, the driver included

children.description: How many of them are children, who need child seats

animals.description: Number of animals travelling with them

luggage.description: How much luggage has to come along

accessibilityNeeds.description: Needs the transport must meet, such as a wheelchair, one entry per need

address.description: Street address of the pick-up, as a person would write it

fromLocation.description: Where the people are to be picked up

address.description: Street address of the destination, as a person would write it

toLocation.description: Where the people want to go

untilAt.description: End of the replacement or accommodation period. Extended automatically when the repair completion date moves, within the limits of the entitlement.

entitlement.description: What the insurer or the membership covers, read before the options are offered so the driver sees what they pay before choosing

coveredAmount.description: Total amount covered for this job, in currency

coveredPerDay.description: Amount covered per day, for a replacement vehicle or accommodation

coveredDays.description: Number of days covered, for a replacement vehicle or accommodation

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount in the entitlement

sourceType.description: What the cover comes from: an InsurancePolicy, an AssistanceMembership, the vehicle owner, or nothing

sourceEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the InsurancePolicy or AssistanceMembership the cover comes from

preferredTypes.description: Kinds of transport the driver prefers, most preferred first

licenceClass.description: Driving licence class the driver holds, for a replacement vehicle

driverAge.description: Age of the driver, for the age limit on a replacement vehicle

willingToPayExcess.description: Whether the driver will pay what the cover does not

notes.description: Anything else the driver asked for, in their own words

driverPreference.description: What the driver asked for, read when the options are chosen

offeredOptions.description: Only options actually available now and in the right place. Recorded so the choice can be audited.

providerEName.description: eName of the provider offering the option

type.description: What kind of transport the option is

price.description: Full price of the option, in the entitlement currency

coveredAmount.description: Part of the price the cover pays

driverPays.description: Part of the price the driver pays

assignedProviderEName.description: eName of the provider whose option was chosen

assignedAssetEName.description: eName of the specific replacement vehicle, where the type is replacementVehicle: a Vehicle whose eVault also holds a ServiceVehicle profile with serviceRole replacement

licenceVerified.description: Checked against age and class restrictions before a replacement vehicle is issued

conditionReportEnvelopeIds.description: A replacement vehicle is condition-reported at handover and at return, using the same object as the rest of the case

out.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ConditionReport written when the replacement vehicle was handed to the driver

in.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ConditionReport written when the replacement vehicle came back

linkedRepairJobEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the RepairJob on the driver's vehicle, whose completion date decides how long a replacement is needed

linkedTransportJobEnvelopeId.description: The return delivery of the repaired vehicle, so the two movements are coordinated instead of arranged separately

status.description: Where the job stands. Every change also writes a CaseEvent.

fallbackToHuman.description: Set when nothing suitable was available and the case fell back to a person. Recorded rather than silent.

costRecordEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the record of what this job cost. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

authorisationEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the payer's decision to pay for this job. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
